cohort: The study included 150 pregnant women aged 18 years or more who were eligible for normal vaginal delivery.
finding: The Mostafa Maged maneuver was found to be effective in statistically decreasing the number of pads used and the volume of blood loss, thus stopping and preventing postpartum bleeding during vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The Mostafa Maged maneuver is applied immediately after placental delivery during normal vaginal delivery to control or prevent postpartum hemorrhage.
followup_time: Observations were taken immediately before and immediately after the application of the Mostafa Maged maneuver after placental delivery.
